source_title: Leo Horoscope Today, October 28, 2026: New Opportunities in Career, Increase in Wealth and Assets - India Today
source_excerpt:
Leo Zodiac Sign Horoscope Prediction Today: Will receive support from seniors. Will move forward confidently. Will have the cooperation of authorities and seniors. Will be encouraged by desired results. Plans will receive support
You will take steps forward without hesitation. Courage will increase in work and business. You will remain sensitive in personal matters. Positivity will prevail at home. Efforts towards profit and management will be strengthened. You will progress through cooperation and wisdom. Maintain natural communication. You will receive support from seniors. Move forward confidently. Support from authorities and seniors will be present. You will be encouraged by desired outcomes. Plans will receive backing. Your position and influence will increase. Professional discussions will improve.
Job and business - Attractive offers will be received. Remarkable performance will continue. You will maintain a supportive attitude. Support from seniors will remain. Expected gains will be made in career and business. You will capitalise on opportunities.
Wealth and property - You will succeed in increasing wealth, crops, and ancestral property. Focus will remain on management. You will work with coordination. Goals will be achieved. There is a possibility of profit from various sources. Interest in government matters will increase.
Love and friendship - Ease in love will increase. Friends will support you. You will take care of relationships. Loved ones will be trustworthy. Close associates will be present. You will meet the expectations of loved ones. Mutual harmony will increase. Relationships will be pleasant. The personal side will be strong. You will earn everyone’s trust. You will share happy moments.
Health and morale - You will maintain balance and a sense of support. Happiness and well-being will increase. Your personality will be attractive. You will emphasise organisation. Health will be good.
